user.title: Hemnyckel
user.description: Pick the lock to manage. Its module must be paired in ZHA.

slot_set_pin.title: Set a PIN
slot_set_pin.description: The code is written to the lock and never stored in Home Assistant.

slot_clear.title: Clear a slot
slot_clear.description: Clears the credential on the lock and forgets the slot's local data.

progress.slot_set_pin: Sending the PIN to the lock...

error.lock_unreachable: The lock did not respond. Press a button on the lock to wake it and try again.

new_slot.title: Slot {slot} needs a name
new_slot.description: A {kind} is registered in slot {slot}. Give the user a name so Home Assistant notifications show the right person.

init.title: Name slot {slot}
init.description: Enter the name of the person using slot {slot}.

set_slot_name.name: Name a lock slot
set_slot_name.description: Stores a person's name for a lock slot so events and notifications say who did what.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The lock slot the credential lives in.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to name a slot on. Leave out to target all of them.

set_pin.name: Write a PIN to a slot
set_pin.description: Writes a PIN code to the real lock and names the slot. The code is never stored in Home Assistant.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The slot to write the code to.

name.name: Name
name.description: Optional person name for the slot.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to act on. Leave out to target all of them.

clear_slot.name: Clear a lock slot
clear_slot.description: Clears the credential on the lock and forgets the slot's local data.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to act on. Leave out to target all of them.

wipe.name: Wipe the lock and every guest
wipe.description: Empties every credential slot above the master slots and removes every guest, in Home Assistant and on the lock. Masters are never touched. Runs as a dry run first; a real run needs confirm: WIPE.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which lock to wipe. Leave out for all of them.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: True lists what would be removed without changing anything.

confirm.name: Confirmation
confirm.description: Type WIPE to run the wipe for real.

clear_repairs.name: Clear repair issues
clear_repairs.description: Deletes every repair issue this integration raised. Home Assistant's own UI can only dismiss them, which leaves them in the registry.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which lock's issues to remove. Leave out for all of them.

read_lock_attributes.name: Read the lock's attributes
read_lock_attributes.description: Reads the lock's standard DoorLock attributes over Zigbee and returns them. PIN codes are never read.

attributes.name: Attributes
attributes.description: Attribute names or ids. Leave out for the default list.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to act on. Leave out to target all of them.

set_auto_lock.name: Set the lock's auto-lock
set_auto_lock.description: Writes the lock's own auto-relock setting over Zigbee and reads it back.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: true turns auto-lock on, false turns it off.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to act on. Leave out to target all of them.

set_sound_volume.name: Set the lock's sound volume
set_sound_volume.description: Writes the lock's own sound volume over Zigbee and reads it back.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to act on. Leave out to target all of them.

fetch_journal.name: Read the lock journal
fetch_journal.description: Returns the lock's timeline of access and admin events, newest last.

person.name: Person
person.description: Only entries whose name contains this text.

action.name: Action
action.description: Only entries with this action, for example unlock or pin_set.

since.name: Since
since.description: Only entries at or after this ISO timestamp.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to read. Leave out to read all of them.

create_guest_code.name: Create a guest code
create_guest_code.description: Writes a PIN to the lock, names the slot and remembers the window. The code is returned once and never stored. Expiry is enforced by Home Assistant, so the code works offline during the window.

code.name: Code
code.description: 4-8 digits. Leave out for a random 6-digit code.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Leave out to use the lowest free user slot.

until.name: Valid until
until.description: ISO timestamp when the code is cleared. Leave out for no expiry.

one_time.name: One-time
one_time.description: The code revokes itself the first time it opens the door.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to use. Leave out for all of them.

revoke_guest_code.name: Revoke a guest code
revoke_guest_code.description: Clears the code now and forgets the guest window.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to use. Leave out for all of them.

list_guests.name: List guest codes
list_guests.description: Returns the active guest windows (names, slots and end times - never the codes).

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to read. Leave out to read all of them.

create_recurring_guest.name: Create a recurring guest
create_recurring_guest.description: A guest whose code never changes but is only valid inside weekly windows. Home Assistant writes the code when a window opens and clears it when it closes.

code.name: Code
code.description: 4-8 digits. Leave out for a random 6-digit code. It stays the same for as long as the guest exists.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: A list of windows: {days: [mon..sun], start: HH:MM, end: HH:MM}. An end at or before the start crosses midnight.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Leave out to use the lowest free user slot.

paused.name: Paused
paused.description: Create it paused; nothing is written to the lock until it is resumed.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to use. Leave out for all.

update_guest.name: Update a guest
update_guest.description: Change a guest's name, code, schedule, pause or expiry; the change takes effect immediately.

code.name: Code
code.description: A new 4-8 digit code; the slot is rewritten.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: New windows (turns a simple guest into a recurring one).

paused.name: Paused
paused.description: Pause or resume a recurring guest.

until.name: Valid until
until.description: New ISO expiry for a simple guest.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to use. Leave out for all.

enroll_fingerprint.name: Start fingerprint enrollment
enroll_fingerprint.description: Lights the lock's fingerprint reader for one slot so the person at the door can enroll a finger. The lock reports nothing while enrolling: a template only exists once that finger has really opened the door.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The slot the finger belongs to.

entry_id.name: Lock
entry_id.description: Which lock; needed when several are configured.
